title: ReCoPII：基于关系的上下文PII掩码数据集构建框架
summary: 提出ReCoPII框架，无需单一数据主体假设，通过本体约束的关系规划、占位符句子生成、代码重建标注及独立LLM校验，从实体关系推导MASK/KEEP标签，构建韩语上下文PII掩码语料ReCoPII-Ko，标注一致率达88.42%，显著优于SPY式增强的26.27%。
summary_en: ReCoPII builds contextual PII masking datasets without assuming a single data subject: it plans ontology-constrained entity relations, generates placeholder sentences, reconstructs annotations via code, verifies with a separate LLM, and derives MASK/KEEP labels from relations. On Korean documents it yields ReCoPII-Ko, with 88.42% annotator agreement versus 26.27% for SPY-style augmentation, and reduces over-masking.
